newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras begun as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Multibras begun as hold.

text.p: Fator Securities said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian home appliance manufacturer Multibras with a hold rating.

- Analyst Persio P. Dangot said in a report the brokerage's recommendation is based on expectations that the company will show weaker results in 1997 due to lower demand and falling prices in the electronic sector.
- said the brokerage estimates Multibras will report a net income of 199.7 million reais in 1997, 18 percent lower than last year.
- Multibras' 1997 earnings, the report said, will be affected mainly by the firm's weak performance in the second and third quarters compared with the same periods of 1996.

- Fator also said it believes "the stock will suffer from the second quarter results but it should become an interesting investment opportunity at around 0.90 reais once the market comes to terms with the new reality of the electronic sector."
- No trades were seen with Multibras stock on the Sao Paulo bolsa so far Friday.
